redfin.remarks: Welcome to South Palm Springs and the beautiful gated community of Esprit which is neatly tucked away in one of the most desirable pockets of the Coachella Valley. This charming 1-bedroom, 1-bath upstairs unit is full of personality and ready to impress. Upon entering, you are greeted by Esprit's signature vaulted ceilings in the great room, where natural light pours in and instantly makes the space feel open, airy, and inviting. The kitchen features refaced cabinetry and matching white appliances that are clean, functional, and move-in ready. The spacious bedroom offers ample closet storage, while the bathroom is appointed with a stall shower and a double vanity. Step outside onto your large private balcony, the perfect spot for morning coffee with peaceful views or an evening glass of wine as the desert sky turns golden. You may never want to leave. Beyond your front door, Esprit delivers resort-style living at every turn. Take a dip in one of two heated pools, soak in any of three spas, or catch a match on the tennis and pickleball courts all framed by lush, tropical landscaping that makes every day feel like a getaway. The location is second to none. Trader Joe's, Target, Starbucks, world-class dining, hiking trails, and the beloved Tahquitz Creek Golf Resort are all just a stone's throw away. This corner of Palm Springs is as scenic and peaceful as it gets yet everything you need is right at your fingertips. The property has one of the city's least expensive land leases, an HOA of just $455/month, and a price point that makes Palm Springs living genuinely attainable, this is an opportunity you won't want to miss. Call for your private showing today!
